discussion.title: SYNTHETIC: choosing storage for a local tool

messages.author: Contributor A
messages.body: We could use JSON files, Redis, or SQLite for src/store.py.

messages.author: Maintainer
messages.body: We reject JSON files because concurrent writes can overwrite each other. We reject Redis because users should not need a separate server. We choose SQLite for src/store.py because it provides transactions in a single local file.

messages.author: Contributor A
messages.body: Agreed. SQLite is the accepted choice for this tool.
